title: Occasion Readiness Before Birthday Week
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftidea:item occasion=*
| eval days_to_event=round((occasion_date-now())/86400,0)
| stats min(days_to_event) as days_to_event, count as ideas, sum(eval(if(status="bought",1,0))) as bought by occasion
| eval pct_ready=round(100*bought/ideas,0)
| where days_to_event<=7
| sort days_to_event
description: Shows which upcoming birthdays or anniversaries are still all idea and no execution.
value: A gift backlog feels productive until the event is a week away and nothing is actually ready.
implementation: Log idea status and occasion dates in `index=personal`; review readiness in the final week before each event.
visualization: Table of upcoming occasions with days left and percentage already bought.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which upcoming occasions are getting close while your gift ideas are still only ideas.
